<h1 id="beastmaster-durzag-combat-achievements" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Beastmaster Durzag Combat Achievements</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/YrMqspEn6R.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This guide will go over how to complete the Grandmaster speed kill Combat achievement for Beastmaster Durzag.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="general-information"><ins><nowiki>General Information</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The base must avoid being melee'd by Beastmaster Durzag so that he does not spawn the 3rd pet. They can do this by running between corners of the room and using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1" alt="dive" title="dive" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to avoid melee swipes.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The base should be the only person to pre-vuln Beastmaster Durzag to avoid other members getting aggro.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Once the waves are about to end, everyone but base should stand on the tile below.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/TM7vrPMdLn.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=NIzAHOaz1Yhro3gfpmLc <nowiki>Grandmaster Speed Killer</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/568262896375824385.png?v=1" alt="grim" title="grim" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643148943856762890.png?v=1" alt="mahj" title="mahj" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be used in place of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626412560395.png?v=1" alt="scriptureofful" title="scriptureofful" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1233722649834684416.png?v=1" alt="equilibriumaura" title="equilibriumaura" kind="icon" /><nowiki> but may be less consistent</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Runes for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1009570755836641331.png?v=1" alt="venggroup" title="venggroup" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are not necessary but can be brought
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FNIzAHOaz1Yhro3gfpmLc.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>

</nowiki>
